args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted, 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
All three final checks passed on every run: rigid-body invariance ≤ 1.11 of 2.0 %/h, closure ≤ 0.22 of 1.0 px/h, plane sections ≤ 2.31 of 3.25 %/h. No run used the width-free ratio.
The large |z| values come from a very small batch spread, not from real outliers. r08's REGR peak (52.92 %/h, z 3.37) is only 0.125 %/h above the median of 52.8 %/h. The 674 µm growth zones in r01, r07 and r08 (z −3.51) are 26 µm (about 4 %) shorter than the 700 µm median.
Every run has the strain-rate profile at the same positions: REGR peak at 421 µm and largest flank difference at 410 µm, with flank differences between −11.7 and −12.4 %/h. The remedy kept in r01 and r07 (registration on non-growing tissue) is the normal path, and no run rolled back a step.
Nothing was flagged, so there is no common pattern to report. One point to check: r02, r03, r04 and r06 have exactly the same check values and summaries, and so do r01 and r07. Confirm these are separate root movies and not duplicate inputs.
